tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: List the current Carpetstory rug collections with their story, materials, knot density, lead time and number of pieces.

tools.name: search_rugs
tools.description: Search hand-knotted rugs by words (motif, mood, colour, place), optionally within one collection or colour family. Returns name, short description, image and product page.

tools.name: get_rug
tools.description: Full details for one rug by its slug (from search_rugs): description, size, colours, collection materials, knot density, lead time, image and page.
